claims.text: Pneumococcal, Hib (inactivated, ⍉live) and meningococcal vaccines; COVID-19 and influenza also recommended.
claims.quote: Pneumococcal, Haemophilus influenzae (inactivated, not live), and meningococcal vaccines. COVID-19 and influenza vaccinations are also recommended. RSV vaccination may be beneficial in adults over 60 years
